_help: Settings for the yt-transcript and yt-notes skills (yt-notes reads this file too). On claude.ai this is the file to edit; on your own computer, edit ~/.yt-notes/config.json instead, which takes priority. Don't put API keys here: on claude.ai use the Supadata / TranscriptAPI connectors, on your computer use environment variables or ~/.yt-notes/config.json.
